verdicts.observation: psionic.lua:49 is the description of the talent type psionic/thought-forms. There, 'psionic summons' means the psionic creatures that get summoned. The target renders it as 灵能召唤术, which means summoning spells or techniques, not the summoned creatures. It should be 灵能召唤物 or equivalent.

misc.lua:90-98, adventurer-letter-2. Several fidelity and completeness problems. (1) 'with a good amount of scorn' and 'Such pluck and derring-do!' are dropped. (2) 'a most hideous, bloated, oozing and chittering horror' becomes 最可怕、最犀利、最凶猛的生物; 犀利 and 凶猛 do not match bloated, oozing or chittering. (3) 'the giant ants' repulsive progenitor' is split into 史前巨型白蚁 plus 蚁王. That changes ants to termites and adds 史前 ('prehistoric'), which the source does not have. The swarm's 'frenzied chitinous young' is also rewritten with an added 巨大的前颚将我碎尸万段. (4) 'revealed to you your folly' is freely rewritten as 世界如此巨大，你又如此渺小, and 'trials I have overcome' becomes 可怕梦魇. (5) The layout does not match. The source has four blank-line paragraph breaks and a blank line before Rolf. The target splits the Old Forest paragraph into an extra paragraph and has only a single line break before 罗尔夫.

world-artifacts.lua:5678, desc of The Titan's Quiver. The target leaves out 'appear to be nearly unbreakable' and 'than any arrow you've ever seen'. 'honed to a vicious sharpness' shrinks to 尖锐. The target is only a summary of the source.

sandworm-lair/objects.lua:109-110. The source has one line break, between the first line and 'It is said...'. The target adds a second line break before 虽然, so the line structure does not match. Also, 'managed to deal a crippling blow by killing their leader' is weakened to 使对方的首领…走向死亡, which drops the meaning of 'crippling blow'.

love-melinda.lua:28. Source: 'died to a Yaech raiding party'. The target drops 'raiding party' and says only 被沙滩上的夺魂魔杀死, so the attackers are no longer a raiding party. The frozen input contains no terminology for Yaech, so this review cannot confirm whether 夺魂魔 is the established name.
